recommendations.governance_health_ratio_watch: Monitor governance posture — health ratio is approaching the action threshold. Review negative signal sources.
recommendations.governance_health_ratio_action: Governance health ratio has crossed the action threshold. Investigate and remediate negative signals.
recommendations.governance_health_ratio_critical: Governance health ratio is critically low. Escalate to executive review immediately.
recommendations.evidence_density_watch: Evidence density is below the expected level. Verify phase execution scripts are producing full artifact sets.
recommendations.evidence_density_action: Evidence density is significantly low. Phase execution may be incomplete. Rerun affected phases.
recommendations.evidence_density_critical: Evidence density is critically low. Evidence integrity is at risk.
recommendations.negative_signal_watch: Negative governance signals are approaching the action threshold. Review flagged evidence files.
recommendations.negative_signal_action: Negative governance signals have crossed the action threshold. Corrective action required.
recommendations.negative_signal_critical: Negative governance signals are critically elevated. Immediate escalation required.
recommendations.closure_signal_watch: Closure signals are below the expected level. Verify end-to-end notification closure governance.
recommendations.closure_signal_action: Closure signals are significantly low. End-to-end notification closure may be incomplete.
recommendations.closure_signal_critical: Closure signals are critically low. Notification closure governance failure.
recommendations.phases_with_evidence_watch: Fewer phases than expected have evidence directories. Verify phase execution coverage.
recommendations.phases_with_evidence_action: Phase evidence coverage is below the action threshold. Multiple phases may be missing evidence.
recommendations.phases_with_evidence_critical: Phase evidence coverage is critically low. Evidence chain integrity is at risk.
